attchmntText: Fiem Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Fiem Industries Limited submitted its Q2FY27 earnings presentation to the BSE and NSE on November 12, 2026. The presentation was uploaded to the company website. Net sales grew from INR 12,075 million in FY21 to INR 27,906 million in FY26. EBITDA grew from INR 1,338 million in FY21 to INR 3,933 million in FY26. Mr. J.K. Jain was re-designated as Executive Chairman effective June 1, 2026. Mr. Rahul Jain was elevated as Managing Director effective June 1, 2026. Ms. Aanchal Jain was re-designated as Joint Managing Director effective June 1, 2026. Mr. Rajesh Sharma was re-designated as Joint Managing Director on November 7, 2023. The company manufactures automotive lighting and rear view mirrors. Major clients include TVS, Honda, Yamaha, Suzuki, Royal Enfield, Hero Motocorp, Piaggio, Tata Motors, Mahindra, Force Motors, Ashok Leyland, and Hyundai.

attchmntText: Fiem Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Fiem Industries Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net sales for the quarter were Rs 93,178.33 lakhs, with a net profit of Rs 8,417.40 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs 31.98. For the six-month period, net sales reached Rs 170,168.05 lakhs, and net profit was Rs 14,935.97 lakhs. The company reported an estimated insurance claim of Rs 82.30 Crores for a fire incident at Unit 8 in Tapukara, Rajasthan, submitted on January 30, 2026. Additionally, Rs 50 Crore was received as an interim payment for the fire incident at Unit 7 in Rai, Haryana. The statutory auditors conducted a limited review of these results.
